task.name: direct_sorting
task.instruction: Sort the red cubes into the red tray and the blue cubes into the blue tray.
task.source: external dual-SO101 MuJoCo project, scripted physical expert

state.timing: measured joint state immediately before the action is issued

action.semantics: absolute joint-position target, left six then right six
action.label_rule: clamped actuator target actually applied at that control frame; never the next measured state

split.rule: successful episodes in collection order: first 16 train, last 4 validation

collection.success_predicate: external SortingTask.evaluate: tray geometry, support/contact, robot clearance, velocity and sustained stability
collection.failure_policy: every attempt and failure reason is kept; a failed attempt never becomes a demonstration

evaluation.purpose: fixed 20-scene engineering diagnostic, not a benchmark
evaluation.scene_freeze: SceneSpec and SHA-256 written before any policy rollout
evaluation.success_predicate: external SortingTask.evaluate, independent of the policy
evaluation.report: success count / 20 with Wilson 95% interval and failure categories

claims.engineering_chain: SO101 20-demo -> 100-update pi0.5 parameter update -> checkpoint restore -> new-checkpoint rollout
